title: Go-Slow Levy
tagline: Airport Road go-slow, one agbero at your window, and Uncle Chuks landing from London at 8pm.

bonus.label: Keep your cash
bonus.lostMessage: Your pocket is empty. The bonus is gone.
bonus.earnedLine: You still have your cash at the end.

short_cash.label: No money left
short_cash.tip: You can't pay your way again.

text.default: Ikeja, 6:30pm. The go-slow has turned Airport Road into a parking lot. Your Bolt hasn't moved in twenty minutes, and Uncle Chuks lands from London at 8. You're in the back seat. So is {rival}. Uncle Chuks has exactly one opening this year - school fees or a job referral - and he's choosing between you two. Whoever looks like they have their life together gets it. Then, knock knock. A young man in a faded vest taps the window. Hand already out. "Oga, anything for the boys?"
text.coop: Ikeja, 6:30pm. The go-slow has turned Airport Road into a parking lot. Your Bolt hasn't moved in twenty minutes, and Uncle Chuks lands from London at 8. You and {partner} are in this together. If you miss him, you'll both hear about it. Then, knock knock. A young man in a faded vest taps the window. Hand already out. "Oga, anything for the boys?"

stakes.default: {rival} is right here. Uncle Chuks' opening goes to one of you. Pay too much and you're broke. Pay nothing and this boy remembers your face.
stakes.coop: Don't let this boy waste your time. Uncle Chuks lands at 8.

choices.label: Wind down slightly, greet him like an old friend: "Chairman! How work?"
Slip him ₦500, tell him to keep the boys off your car
Wave your hand dismissively: "I'm a civil servant, I don't have money for this"
Keep the window up, quietly ask Mr. Femi who this man is

recap.default: {winner} winds down and greets him like a friend. The boy smiles, shows a chipped front tooth. "Chairman? You sabi talk am." He leans on the door, ready to chat. {loser} is already checking their phone.
recap.coop: You wind down and greet him like a friend. The boy smiles, shows a chipped front tooth. "Chairman? You sabi talk am." He leans on the door, ready to chat.

recap.default: {winner} slips him ₦500. He doesn't even count it, just pockets it smooth. "You get sense." The other boys see the exchange and move to the next car. {loser} watches the money go.
recap.coop: You slip him ₦500. He doesn't even count it, just pockets it smooth. "You get sense." The other boys see the exchange and move to the next car.

recap.default: {winner} waves him off like a beggar. The boy's face changes. He doesn't shout, he just steps back and looks at the car like he's memorising it. {loser} sinks into their seat.
recap.coop: You wave him off like a beggar. The boy's face changes. He doesn't shout, he just steps back and looks at the car like he's memorising it.

recap.default: {winner} asks Mr. Femi quietly. Mr. Femi hisses. "Na Kayode. He dey here every evening. Just give him something small." {loser} is watching the window.
recap.coop: You ask Mr. Femi quietly. Mr. Femi hisses. "Na Kayode. He dey here every evening. Just give him something small."

recap.default: {winner} tries the greeting but the window is only open a crack. Kayode has to bend down to hear. "You dey fear me?" He laughs, but it's not friendly. {loser} looks away.
recap.coop: You try the greeting but the window is only open a crack. Kayode has to bend down to hear. "You dey fear me?" He laughs, but it's not friendly.

recap.default: {winner} fumbles for cash and drops a ₦200 note. Kayode looks at it like it's dirty. "Oga, this one no fit buy pure water." {loser} sees {winner}'s empty hand.
recap.coop: You fumble for cash and drop a ₦200 note. Kayode looks at it like it's dirty. "Oga, this one no fit buy pure water."

recap.default: {winner} asks Mr. Femi, but Mr. Femi is already arguing with a bike man who scratched his mirror. "Oga, I no know the boy name. Just settle am." {loser} is watching the clock.
recap.coop: You ask Mr. Femi, but Mr. Femi is already arguing with a bike man who scratched his mirror. "Oga, I no know the boy name. Just settle am."

tie.recap: Neither of you moves. Kayode taps the window again, harder this time. "Oga, I dey talk to you."

text.default: Kayode has leaned halfway through your window. He smells like sweat and the kind of perfume they sell in sachets. His vest has a stain that might be engine oil. "Computer Village," he's saying. "I dey sell accessories. Then task force come scatter everything." He shrugs like it was weather. "Now I dey manage traffic." He points ahead. "Trailer don break down under the bridge. Another hour minimum." Then he drops his voice: "But my guy, I know back road through Ajao Estate. Twenty minutes to airport. The gate people go want something small, though." Behind you, {rival} is watching your phone. The screen just lit up - Uncle Chuks is calling.

tie.recap: You both freeze. Kayode looks from one window to the other, then laughs. "Two of una dey fear?" He taps both windows. "Make una decide quick. Traffic dey move."

text.default: The boys have opened the service lane. Mr. Femi guns the engine and the car lurches forward, leaving the go-slow behind. But the lane is narrow, barely wide enough for one car, and it's filling with okadas and other desperate drivers. A danfo is trying to force its way in from the left. Mr. Femi's knuckles are white on the steering wheel. "These people no get sense," he's muttering. Ahead, the lane splits - left goes toward the airport main road, right dips into a muddy stretch behind some shops. The danfo is still pushing in. Uncle Chuks just texted: "Landed. Waiting."

text.default: The estate gate is just a metal bar across a potholed road. Two boys in matching vests sit on plastic chairs, collecting toll. One of them recognises Kayode's voice on Mr. Femi's phone - you called ahead like he said. "Kayode people?" He lifts the bar without asking for money. But the other one is looking at {rival}. "This one na two people. Where the other one money?" Behind you, another car is honking. The bar is still up, but the second boy's hand is on it.

Waiting. Where una?"
text.solo: The Chairman is a thick man in a white native, sitting on the bonnet of a Lexus that's seen better days. He doesn't stand when you approach. "So na you dey disturb my boys?" His voice is quiet, almost gentle. Two men in vests flank him. Behind them, the road is still blocked. Uncle Chuks just texted: "Landed. Waiting. Where you?"

stakes.default: The Chairman controls this road. {rival} is watching to see if you fold or fight.
stakes.coop: The Chairman controls this road. Show respect or show strength, but don't show fear.

choices.label: Greet him properly, hands together: "Chairman, good evening. Small misunderstanding. We dey rush airport."
Offer to settle everyone - pay the boys and something for the Chairman
Tell him your uncle is a government official and he should let you pass
Apologise for the trouble, ask his name, and promise to pass his greeting to Uncle Chuks

recap.default: {winner} greets him proper and the Chairman actually smiles. "You get home training." He signals and the road opens. {loser} is still standing there, unsure what to do.
recap.coop: You greet him proper and the Chairman actually smiles. "You get home training." He signals and the road opens.

recap.default: {winner} pays and the Chairman counts it without looking at the amount. "You get sense." The road opens. {loser} is still arguing about the price.
recap.coop: You pay and the Chairman counts it without looking at the amount. "You get sense." The road opens.

recap.default: {winner} bluffs and the Chairman's smile disappears. "Government?" He stands up. "Make I see your ID." The men step closer. {loser} slips away in the confusion.
recap.coop: You bluff and the Chairman's smile disappears. "Government?" He stands up. "Make I see your ID." The men step closer.

recap.default: {winner} apologises and asks his name. "Alhaji." "Alhaji, my Uncle Chuks go hear your name." The Chairman nods. "Tell am Chairman send greeting." The road opens. {loser} is still trying to negotiate.
recap.coop: You apologise and ask his name. "Alhaji." "Alhaji, my Uncle Chuks go hear your name." The Chairman nods. "Tell am Chairman send greeting." The road opens.

recap.default: {winner} greets but stumbles over the Yoruba. The Chairman's eyes narrow. "You dey mock me?" {loser} stays quiet and he lets them pass.
recap.coop: You greet but stumble over the Yoruba. The Chairman's eyes narrow. "You dey mock me?"

recap.default: {winner} offers money but it's not enough. The Chairman looks at it like it's dirty. "You think say na beggar I be?" {loser} adds more and gets through.
recap.coop: You offer money but it's not enough. The Chairman looks at it like it's dirty. "You think say na beggar I be?"

recap.default: {winner} bluffs and the Chairman laughs. Then he stops laughing. "Carry this one go side." Two men grab {winner}'s arms. {loser} watches from the car as it happens.
recap.coop: You bluff and the Chairman laughs. Then he stops laughing. "Carry this one go side." Two men grab your arms.

recap.default: {winner} apologises but mentions the wrong name. "Who be that one?" The Chairman's face hardens. {loser} keeps quiet and slips past.
recap.coop: You apologise but mention the wrong name. "Who be that one?" The Chairman's face hardens.

tie.recap: You both try different approaches. The Chairman gets annoyed. "Una dey waste my time." He makes you both pay double before he lets you through.

text.default: The road opens up. Mr. Femi accelerates and the airport sign appears ahead - 2km. Your phone buzzes. Uncle Chuks: "Landed. Waiting." Then another text: "{rival} say dem dey close." He's tracking both of you. The car ahead is slowing down. LASTMA checkpoint. Two officers in reflective vests are waving cars to the side. One of them is looking at your Bolt like he has questions.
text.coop: The road opens up. Mr. Femi accelerates and the airport sign appears ahead - 2km. Your phone buzzes. Uncle Chuks: "Landed. Waiting." Then another text: "Make una hurry." He's tracking both of you. The car ahead is slowing down. LASTMA checkpoint. Two officers in reflective vests are waving cars to the side. One of them is looking at your Bolt like he has questions.
text.solo: The road opens up. Mr. Femi accelerates and the airport sign appears ahead - 2km. Your phone buzzes. Uncle Chuks: "Landed. Waiting." The car ahead is slowing down. LASTMA checkpoint. Two officers in reflective vests are waving cars to the side. One of them is looking at your Bolt like he has questions.

stakes.default: Almost there. {rival} is close behind. One wrong move with LASTMA and you're both late.
stakes.coop: Almost there. Don't let LASTMA slow you down now.

choices.label: Smile, wind down: "Officer, good evening. We dey rush pick person for airport."
Have your cash ready, slip it with your licence when he asks
Tell him you're a government official on official business and he should wave you through
Ask Mr. Femi if his papers are complete before the officer reaches you

recap.default: {winner} smiles and the officer actually smiles back. "Oga, make una dey go. But slow down." He waves you through. {loser} is still digging for their licence.
recap.coop: You smile and the officer actually smiles back. "Oga, make una dey go. But slow down." He waves you through.

recap.default: {winner} pays and the officer doesn't even check the licence. "Make una dey go." The money disappears into his pocket. {loser} is still answering questions.
recap.coop: You pay and the officer doesn't even check the licence. "Make una dey go." The money disappears into his pocket.

recap.default: {winner} bluffs and the officer's face changes. "Government?" He pulls out his phone. "Make I verify." {loser} shows proper ID and gets through while you're stuck.
recap.coop: You bluff and the officer's face changes. "Government?" He pulls out his phone. "Make I verify."

recap.default: {winner} asks Mr. Femi and he produces everything - licence, insurance, hackney permit. The officer checks, nods, waves you through. {loser} is missing their insurance and has to pay.
recap.coop: You ask Mr. Femi and he produces everything - licence, insurance, hackney permit. The officer checks, nods, waves you through.

recap.default: {winner} smiles but it's the wrong kind of smile. The officer frowns. "Oga, park well." {loser} drove past while he's focused on you.
recap.coop: You smile but it's the wrong kind of smile. The officer frowns. "Oga, park well."

recap.default: {winner} offers cash but the officer is new. He looks at the money like it's poison. "Oga, you wan bribe me?" {loser} shows ID and gets through.
recap.coop: You offer cash but the officer is new. He looks at the money like it's poison. "Oga, you wan bribe me?"

recap.default: {winner} bluffs and the officer laughs. Then he stops laughing. "Park well. Now." {loser} slips past while he's writing your ticket.
recap.coop: You bluff and the officer laughs. Then he stops laughing. "Park well. Now."

recap.default: {winner} asks Mr. Femi but he's missing his hackney permit. "Oga, I no renew am." The officer hears. "Park well." {loser}'s driver has everything.
recap.coop: You ask Mr. Femi but he's missing his hackney permit. "Oga, I no renew am." The officer hears. "Park well."

tie.recap: You both reach the checkpoint together. The officer is overwhelmed. "Make una just dey go." He waves both cars through without checking either.

text.default: The arrivals hall is chaos. Two flights just landed. People everywhere, trolleys blocking the walkway, a child crying in the corner. You scan the crowd. Then you see him - Uncle Chuks, in his London jacket, looking at his phone. He hasn't seen you yet. {rival} is two steps behind you, breathing hard.
text.coop: The arrivals hall is chaos. Two flights just landed. People everywhere, trolleys blocking the walkway, a child crying in the corner. You scan the crowd. Then you see him - Uncle Chuks, in his London jacket, looking at his phone. He hasn't seen you yet. {partner} is right beside you, breathing hard.
text.solo: The arrivals hall is chaos. Two flights just landed. People everywhere, trolleys blocking the walkway, a child crying in the corner. You scan the crowd. Then you see him - Uncle Chuks, in his London jacket, looking at his phone. He hasn't seen you yet.

stakes.default: Uncle Chuks is right there. {rival} is right behind you. Whoever reaches him first gets the opening.
stakes.coop: Uncle Chuks is right there. Reach him together or not at all.

choices.label: Shout his name, wave your hand high: "Uncle Chuks! Over here!"
Sprint through the crowd, push past the trolleys
Tell a security guard you're with the man in the London jacket and he should let you through
Walk calmly, let Uncle Chuks see you looking composed while {rival} is sweating

recap.default: {winner} shouts and Uncle Chuks looks up. His face breaks into a smile. "My pikin!" He opens his arms. {loser} is still pushing through the crowd.
recap.coop: You shout and Uncle Chuks looks up. His face breaks into a smile. "My pikin!" He opens his arms.

recap.default: {winner} sprints and reaches him first, sweating and breathless. Uncle Chuks laughs. "You dey run race?" {loser} arrives thirty seconds later, also breathless.
recap.coop: You sprint and reach him first, sweating and breathless. Uncle Chuks laughs. "You dey run race?"

recap.default: {winner} grabs a guard and he actually listens. "That man there?" He clears a path. Uncle Chuks sees you coming like a VIP. {loser} is still stuck behind a trolley.
recap.coop: You grab a guard and he actually listens. "That man there?" He clears a path. Uncle Chuks sees you coming like a VIP.

recap.default: {winner} walks calm and composed. Uncle Chuks sees you and nods approvingly. "You look like person wey get sense." {loser} arrives sweating and dishevelled.
recap.coop: You walk calm and composed. Uncle Chuks sees you and nods approvingly. "You look like person wey get sense."

recap.default: {winner} shouts but it's the wrong name. "Uncle Chike!" Uncle Chuks doesn't look up. {loser} reaches him while you're still shouting.
recap.coop: You shout but it's the wrong name. "Uncle Chike!" Uncle Chuks doesn't look up.

recap.default: {winner} sprints but trips on a trolley. Falls hard. Uncle Chuks sees. "Who be that one?" {loser} reaches him clean.
recap.coop: You sprint but trip on a trolley. Falls hard. Uncle Chuks sees. "Who be that one?"

recap.default: {winner} grabs a guard but he doesn't care. "Oga, comot for here." He pushes you back. {loser} slips past.
recap.coop: You grab a guard but he doesn't care. "Oga, comot for here." He pushes you back.

recap.default: {winner} walks too slow. Uncle Chuks turns and sees {loser} first. "My pikin!" {loser} gets the hug, you get the view.
recap.coop: You walk too slow. Uncle Chuks turns and sees {partner} first. "My pikin!"

tie.recap: You both reach him at the same time, from opposite sides. Uncle Chuks looks from one to the other, confused but happy. "Una come together?"

text.default: You reach the arrivals hall but Uncle Chuks is already at the exit, trolley in hand. He sees you and his face falls. "You miss am. I don wait tire." {rival} is already there, looking guilty but relieved. Uncle Chuks sighs. "Make una help me carry bag. At least una fit do that one."
text.coop: You reach the arrivals hall but Uncle Chuks is already at the exit, trolley in hand. He sees you and his face falls. "You miss am. I don wait tire." {partner} is beside you, both of you looking guilty. Uncle Chuks sighs. "Make una help me carry bag. At least una fit do that one."
text.solo: You reach the arrivals hall but Uncle Chuks is already at the exit, trolley in hand. He sees you and his face falls. "You miss am. I don wait tire." He sighs. "Help me carry bag. At least you fit do that one."

stakes.default: You missed him. Now you have to make up for it or {rival} gets everything.
stakes.coop: You missed him together. Now make it right together.

choices.label: Laugh it off: "Uncle, Lagos traffic no be your mate. But we here now."
Grab the heaviest bag immediately, don't wait to be asked
Blame the driver: "Mr. Femi take wrong road. We try our best."
Say sorry and mean it, then carry his heavy bag without being asked

endings.win: You reach him late, but {loser} reached him later. Uncle Chuks sighs and picks the lesser disappointment: the opening is yours, with a lecture about time attached.
endings.loss: You reach him late and {winner} is already pushing the trolley. The opening is gone, and so is the drive home's good mood. You carry the small bag.

success.default: You reach him late and sweating, and he sighs, hugs you both and says nothing about the two hours.
success.solo: You reach him late and sweating, and he sighs, hugs you and says nothing about the two hours.

endings.fail: By the time you reach arrivals, Uncle Chuks has already taken a taxi. He will remind you every Christmas.

text.default: You made it in time, but trouble followed you. Someone from the road is at the arrivals gate watching you, and Uncle Chuks has noticed. "Who is that one? Why is he looking at you like that?" You have seconds to explain. {rival} is standing right there, listening.
text.coop: You made it in time, but trouble followed you. Someone from the road is at the arrivals gate watching you, and Uncle Chuks has noticed. "Who is that one? Why is he looking at you like that?" You have seconds to explain. {partner} is standing right there, waiting to see what you say.
text.solo: You made it in time, but trouble followed you. Someone from the road is at the arrivals gate watching you, and Uncle Chuks has noticed. "Who is that one? Why is he looking at you like that?" You have seconds to explain.

stakes.default: He has seen the trouble. Explain before he picks {rival} instead.
stakes.coop: Keep Uncle Chuks out of this mess.

choices.label: Laugh it off: "Uncle, that's an old friend. Let's go, I'm hungry!"
Quickly steer him and the trolley toward the car park
Say the man is a church friend who was just surprised to see you
Give him the short honest version: "Small road trouble. All good. Let's go."

endings.win: You reach Uncle Chuks first, but trouble followed you and he noticed. You explain fast enough that he still hands you the opening, with a warning. {loser} carries the small bag and the gossip.
endings.loss: You reach him, but trouble followed you and {winner} is already telling him the clean version. The opening goes to them. You carry the small bag.

success.default: You reach him together, trouble trailing a little behind. He asks questions all the way to the car, and the drive home is long.
success.solo: You reach him with trouble trailing behind you. He asks questions all the way to the car, and the drive home is long.

endings.fail: Trouble followed you to arrivals and Uncle Chuks saw all of it. He will bring it up at Christmas.

endings.win: You reach Uncle Chuks first, and he gives you the opening. {loser} carries the small bag. At Christmas, the family will hear your name.
endings.loss: {winner} reaches Uncle Chuks first, and the opening goes to them. You carry the small bag. The drive home is silent.

success.default: You reach him together, tired and sweating, and he hugs you both. He says he's never seen two people so happy to see an airport.
success.solo: You reach him tired and sweating, and he hugs you tight. He says he's never seen someone so happy to see an airport.

fail.default: By the time you reach arrivals, Uncle Chuks has already taken a taxi. He will remind you every Christmas.
fail.solo: By the time you reach arrivals, Uncle Chuks has already taken a taxi. He will remind you every Christmas.

epilogues.text: Kayode calls Mr. Femi the next day to ask if you reached safely. You have a friend on Airport Road now.
Kayode still remembers your face. Avoid Airport Road for a while.
Your ₦500 has circulated the boys' WhatsApp group. Everyone knows you pay.
You check your pocket that night and almost cry.
The video of you shouting "government" on Airport Road is still circulating two days later.
Mr. Femi saves your number. Next time he'll come for you himself.
Mr. Femi gives you one star and a very long comment.
You know the Ajao Estate back road now, and you're not telling anybody.
